text: This report recommends the retroactive approval of the Quotation for the Generator Installation at African Rainforest Pavilion, RFQ 27 (2018-07). Due to the urgency of having the new generator in place before the winter season a decision was made to proceed with the installation of the generator and to seek retroactive approval at the next Board meeting.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Concurred with the actions of the Chair of the Board of Management and Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo in approving the quotation for Generator Installation - African Rainforest Pavilion (RFQ27, 2018-07) to be awarded to Tri-Unite Systems in the amount of $410,563.00, including applicable taxes.
